name: fuzzy_trade
frozen: 2026-10-04, before any real-data run (one smoke test on a generated iid walk only)
question: Does a fuzzy inference system - expert rules (FIS-1) or rules learned by Wang-Mendel (FIS-2) - pick a trade side that beats a coin twin, matched iid and GARCH walks, and the same rules with hard thresholds?

inputs.causality: every input is known at bar t's close; entry is at bar t+1's open

definitions.ATR: Wilder ATR(14) as an EWM with alpha 1/14 of the true range
definitions.TR: (close - EMA(50) of close) / ATR(14): trend as distance from the average
definitions.SLOPE: (EMA50[t] - EMA50[t-5]) / (5 ATR14[t]): the average's slope in ATR a bar
definitions.VOL: log(ATR(5) / ATR(50)), both Wilder: the volatility state (compression below, expansion above)
definitions.RPOS: (close - lowest low of 20 bars) / (highest high - lowest low), bar t included; 0.5 on a zero range
definitions.CDIR: MCFL candle direction as a signed body share (close - open) / (high - low), 0 on a zero range
definitions.CLOC: MCFL close location (close - low) / (high - low), the continuous form of the close quartile; 0.5 on a zero range
definitions.CFORCE: MCFL body force: z of |close - open| / ATR(14) in its rolling 10-bar window with the current bar in (mcfl.candles._rolling, PERIOD 10, as force_g)
definitions.CSIZE: MCFL size: z of the range high - low in the same rolling 10-bar window (as the size class); computed, used by no rule
definitions.DSL: (close - the last confirmed swing low) / ATR(14); a swing low is the lowest low of 3 bars either side, known 3 bars after it
definitions.DSH: (the last confirmed swing high - close) / ATR(14)
definitions.SWING: (DSL - DSH) / (|DSL| + |DSH|): -1 at the swing low, +1 at the swing high

breakpoint_quantiles.source: every pre-2024 bar (label horizon inside 2023) of the MT5 non-Deriv real series, 1h, 4h and 1d pooled
breakpoint_quantiles.note: signed inputs (TR, SLOPE, MOM) use quantiles of |x| so the sets are mirror-symmetric; DIST pools the positive DSL and DSH values

sets.ramp(x, a, b): 0 at or below a, 1 at or above b, linear between
sets.X_POS / X_NEG (X in TR, SLOPE, MOM): ramp(x, 0, b) / ramp(-x, 0, b); FLAT is what is left
sets.X_EXT_POS / X_EXT_NEG: ramp(x, b, c) / ramp(-x, b, c): EXTENDED, overbought / oversold
sets.VOL_COMPRESSED / VOL_EXPANDED: 1 - ramp(VOL, q10, q50) / ramp(VOL, q50, q90)
sets.FORCE_STRONG: ramp(CFORCE, 0, 1): 0.5 at MCFL's STRONG edge (z = 0.5), 1 at DOMINANT (z = 1)
sets.CLOSE_HIGH / CLOSE_LOW: ramp(CLOC, 0.5, 1) / ramp(1 - CLOC, 0.5, 1): 0.5 at MCFL's Q4 / Q1 edge (0.75 / 0.25)
sets.STRONG_BULL / STRONG_BEAR: min(BULL, FORCE_STRONG, CLOSE_HIGH) / min(BEAR, FORCE_STRONG, CLOSE_LOW)
sets.NEAR_SUPPORT: on DSL: 1 from 0 to dist q25, falling to 0 at q50; below the swing low (a sweep) 1 at 0 falling to 0 at -q25

fis1.kind: Mamdani-style rules with AND = min, NOT = 1 - mu; zero-order (singleton) consequents on the long strength, defuzzified by the weighted average (the centroid of singletons)
fis1.long_strength: L = sum(w_r c_r) / (background_weight + sum(w_r)); the background rule says 'otherwise long is WEAK' (c = 0)
fis1.short: the short strength S is the same rule base on the flipped chart (prices negated, highs and lows swapped), which mirrors every input

rules.name: L1_pullback_in_uptrend
rules.if: UPTREND and RPOS_LOW and not MOM_NEG
rules.source: buy the dip in an uptrend (trend filter + pullback; fuzzy-trading literature, e.g. Dourra and Siy 2002; Chang and Liu 2008)

rules.name: L2_trend_momentum
rules.if: UPTREND and MOM_POS and not MOM_EXT_POS
rules.source: momentum with the trend, not overbought

rules.name: L3_bull_candle_at_support
rules.if: not SLOPE_NEG and NEAR_SUPPORT and STRONG_BULL
rules.source: a strong bullish candle at support (the fuzzy candlestick-pattern literature, e.g. Lee et al.)

rules.name: L4_compression_breakout
rules.source: volatility contraction then a forceful break up

rules.name: L5_oversold_reversal
rules.source: RSI oversold with a bullish reversal candle

rules.name: L6_exhaustion
rules.source: uptrend, close extended, strong bear candle: long is WEAK

rules.name: L9_expanding_selloff
rules.source: do not buy a volatile sell-off

fis1.crisp_version: every elementary set's membership replaced by 1[mu >= 0.5] (the hard threshold at each set's crossover) before the rules; the same rules, background weight, score and thresholds

fis2.kind: Wang-Mendel rule learning on 8 inputs, each with 3 Ruspini triangular sets (shoulders at the outer peaks): 3^8 = 6561 cells
fis2.target: +1 when the high reaches close + 1.5 ATR(14) before the low reaches close - 1.5 ATR within the next 24 bars, -1 the other way, 0 neither or both on one bar
fis2.training: MT5 non-Deriv real bars before 2024-01-01 (label horizon ending before it), 1h, 4h and 1d pooled
fis2.learning: each sample generates the rule of its max-membership cell with degree = product of those memberships; conflicts resolved by the degree-weighted mean consequent (in [-1, 1]); a cell needs total degree >= min_support to hold a rule
fis2.inference: score = sum over cells of (product membership x consequent) / sum of product membership over cells holding a rule; 0 when none fires
fis2.baseline: logistic regression (sklearn, C = 1) on the same 8 crisp inputs, standardised on training, fit on resolved (+1 / -1) training bars; score = 2p - 1
fis2.threshold_rule: trade when |score| crosses the given quantile of |score| on the training bars (computed for FIS-2 and the logistic separately)
fis2.scored_on: 2024-01-01 onward for AUC; trades reported before and after the split, the 'after' half being out of sample for FIS-2 and the logistic

trade.entry: a crossing: |score| reaches the threshold at bar t's close on a side it was not on at t-1; enter at t+1's open on the score's side; every crossing is taken (overlap allowed)
trade.stop: beyond the last 3 bars' extreme (bars t-2..t) with a 0.1 ATR(14)[t] pad; skipped if the open is already beyond it

exits.E1: primary: the initial stop on the entry bar, then a 2-ATR(t) trail behind completed bars' best high (low for shorts)
exits.X2: fixed 2R target against the initial stop; stop first when both on one bar

trade.costs: MT5: the broker's spread floor (run.spread_floor) in price; Binance: 0.07% of price; R net of cost / risk
trade.P_NR: P(the trade's best excursion under E1 reaches N R) for N in 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 10, against 1/(N+1)

controls.walks: synth.walk (iid) and synth.garch matched to each series (sigma = sd of close-to-close changes), 256 sub-steps a bar, the real timestamps, the real cost in ATR units; the FIS runs unchanged with the breakpoints and FIS-2 rules from real training data
controls.coin_twin: the same entry bars as each system at each threshold, a random side (seeded per series), the same stop rule and exits
controls.crisp: the FIS-1 rules with hard thresholds (fis1.crisp_version)

data.mt5: every symbol in run.FAMILY (FX, metals, indices, energy, crypto CFDs; Deriv synthetics reported apart, never a control), 1h, 4h, 1d, the broker's bars in MT5BT_DB

primary.cell: FIS-1, |score| >= 0.5, MT5 non-Deriv pooled, all timeframes, E1
primary.pass: mean R > 0 with the day-bootstrap 90% interval above 0; positive before and after 2024-01-01; above its coin twin, above the iid walk and the GARCH walk (same system on them), and above the crisp version

secondary.cells: every real cell of FIS-1, crisp, FIS-2 and the logistic x threshold grid x exit (E1, X2) x pool (MT5 pooled, MT5 fx / metal / index / energy / crypto, Deriv, Binance), the primary excluded; FIS-2 held-out AUC against the logistic's
secondary.p_value: one-sided day-bootstrap: the share of 2000 resampled means at or below 0
secondary.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all secondary cells at q = 0.10; a cell counts only if it survives BH and beats its coin twin, iid walk and GARCH walk
